_source: Task 0 follow-up probe (#11), Claude Code 2.1.277, 2026-09-29. PostToolBatch payload for a parallel batch of three Bash calls, two succeeding and one failing ('exit 5'). Fired once for the whole batch, timed to start only after the batch's own PostToolUse/PostToolUseFailure hooks (each artificially delayed) had completed. tool_calls carries every call's tool_name, tool_input, tool_use_id, and tool_response (a string for both success and failure). A parallel test of additionalContext + continue: false on this event confirmed both take effect: additionalContext appears in the transcript as a hook_additional_context attachment, and continue: false ends the session with terminal_reason 'hook_stopped' before the next assistant turn.
